properties.NAME: ILLINOIS (Va., ext)
properties.CHANGE: ILLINOIS County (Va., extinct) created by Virginia to encompass all territory N and W of the Ohio Riv. & east of the Mississippi Riv. claimed by Virginia on the basis of its 1609 charter; ILLINOIS County included all of present Minn. E of Miss. Riv.

properties.NAME: Eur. Possessions
properties.CHANGE: Between the Treaty of Paris (10 Feb 1763) and the Louisiana Purchase (30 Apr 1803) parts of Minnesota west of Mississippi River/Lake of the Woods belonged variously to Great Britain, France, and Spain.

properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Virginia ceded to the United States its charter to territory northwest of the river Ohio. That part of present Minnesota east of the Mississippi River became unorganized federal territory.

properties.NAME: Northwest Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The U.S. created the Territory of the United States Northwest of the River Ohio (Northwest Territory) from unorganized federal territory. Map depicts non-county area of the Northwest Territory in present Minnesota.

properties.NAME: Indiana Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Indiana Territory from the Northwest Territory; it included all of present Minnesota east of the Mississippi River.
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 3:86-88; U.S. Stat., vol.2, ch. 41 [1800]/pp. 58-59)

properties.NAME: ST. CLAIR (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: As an Indiana Territory county (created in 1790), ST. CLAIR (Ill.) gained non-county area in Indiana Territory, gained from KNOX (Ind.), and lost to RANDOLPH (Ill.). ST. CLAIR (Ill.) included territory in present Ill., Ind., Minn., Mich., and Wis.
properties.CITATION: (Ind. Terr., Exec. Journal, 98-100; Pence and Armstrong, 212, 520)

properties.NAME: ST. CLAIR (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: As Indiana Territory counties, ST. CLAIR (Ill.) exchanged with RANDOLPH (Ill.); area within present Minnesota was unchanged.

properties.NAME: ST. CLAIR (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: ST. CLAIR (Ill.) lost to creation of WAYNE (Indiana Territory, extinct). Area in present Minnesota was unchanged.
properties.CITATION: (Ind. Terr., Exec. Journal, 114-115; Pence and Armstrong, 218; U.S. Stat., vol. 2, ch. 40 [1802], secs. 1-3/pp. 173-174; Van Zandt, 112)

properties.NAME: ST. CHARLES (Mo.)
properties.CHANGE: St. Charles District (now ST. CHARLES, Mo.) created as one of five districts by District of Louisiana (renamed Louisiana Territory in 1805). St. Charles District included all of present Minnesota west of the Mississippi River.

properties.NAME: Uncert. Bdry. Area
properties.CHANGE: The boundary from Lake of the Woods to the Rocky Mtns. between the United States and the British Possessions was unsettled.

properties.NAME: ST. CLAIR (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: ST. CLAIR (Ill.) expanded when officially re-created by Illinois Territory continuing de facto county of the same name created by Northwest Territory in 1790. Area in present Minnesota was unchanged.

properties.NAME: MADISON (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: MADISON (Ill.) created by Illinois Territory from RANDOLPH (Ill.) and ST. CLAIR (Ill.); MADISON included part of present Minnesota.

properties.NAME: Missouri Terr.
properties.CHANGE: As a Missouri Territory county, ST. CHARLES (Mo.) lost to non-county area. That part of ST. CHARLES in present Minnesota became non-county area in Missouri Territory.
properties.CITATION: (Laws of a Pub. and Gen. Nature of the State of Mo., 1:ch.99/ pp. 293-295)

properties.NAME: MADISON (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: As an Illinois Territory county, MADISON (Ill.) lost to creation of EDWARDS (Ill.) in present Illinois, Michigan, and Wisconsin. Area within present Minnesota was unchanged.

properties.NAME: MADISON (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: As an Illinois county, MADISON (Ill.) lost to creation of BOND (Ill.) in present Illinois, Michigan, and Wisconsin; area within present Minnesota was unchanged.

properties.NAME: CRAWFORD (Wis.)
properties.CHANGE: CRAWFORD (Wis.) created by Michigan Territory from non-county areas that were formerly part of Illinois Territory; included part of present Minnesota.

properties.NAME: MICHILIMACKINAC (Mi)
properties.CHANGE: MICHILIMACKINAC (now MACKINAC, Mich.) created by Michigan Territory from WAYNE (Mich.), non-county area in Michigan, and non-county areas that were formerly part of Illinois Territory; included parts of present Minnesota.

properties.NAME: Missouri Terr.
properties.CHANGE: A Convention of Commerce bet. Great Britain and the US established the parallel of 49 deg N lat, from Lake of the Woods to the Rocky Mts., as the N bdry. bet the US and British possessions. Missouri Terr. included all of Minnesota west of the Miss. Riv.

properties.NAME: MICHILIMACKINAC (Mi)
properties.CHANGE: As a Michigan Territory county, MICHILIMACKINAC (now MACKINAC, Mich.) lost to non-county area; area within present Minnesota was unchanged.

properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The state of Missouri was created from Missouri Territory; Missouri Territory eliminated. All the former territory north and west of the present state became unorganized federal territory. Portion of unorg. fed. terr. in present Minnesota mapped here.
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 15:742-744; U.S. Stat., vol. 3, ch. 22 [1820]/ pp. 545-548; Van Zandt, 117)

properties.NAME: MICHILIMACKINAC (Mi)

properties.NAME: CRAWFORD (Wis.)

properties.NAME: de facto Wis. Terr.
